effects.display_name: Native reactive Scarab actor/owner/color combat family
effects.actual_behavior: ScarabSummon extends TamableAnimal. baseTick calls parent,then native helper,then refreshDimensions; aiStep parent then swing update then setNoGravity(true). Helper health<=1 server-discard occurs first but does not return. EVERY call independently queues5 to set despawnable=true and350 to server-discard, with no alive/owner recheck; these repeated queues are native, not a new deduplicated lifetime. Untamed with Player in full-side15 tames to nearest Player, not an incoming-hit owner/flag-filtered Player. Tamed checks owner identity in inflate3; if absent and owner nonnull, absolute homing divides by unshifted three-dimensional owner distance, Y numerator adds.6, factor.3; no added zero-distance guard. First unlocked call sets variantlock=true BEFORE checking owner, so ownerless calls can lock none. Clears six synchronized found-color flags; only other tame same-owner Scarabs in inflate12.5 populate them. Separate foundotherscarab boolean tests ANY other entity same owner, but has no additional gameplay reader in this helper. Starts gold, sequentially downgrades through purple/iridescent/greengold/green/brown when owner color count<=0 OR matching color found OR Player matching sealed-item cooldown OR owner justsummoned-color false; final invalid brown server-discard. No reevaluation after lock. Tamed nonnull-owner count-sum<=0 server-discard. Query inflate7.5, owner Player identity only: native Resistance5/amps brown0,green1,greengold1,iridescent2,purple2,gold3 each call, no effect-applier argument/hurt-success check. Non-brown/non-green dashtime<=0: with target write absolute yaw motion(X divisor2,currentY,Z divisor8),then reset20 even without target;positive decrements1. Gold target Slow10/1 then self Strength10/1;purple target Slow10/0 then self Strength10/0;iridescent/green/greengold self Weakness10/0;brown self Weakness10/1, all server Living requests with flags false,false and ignored returns. Tamed nonnull-owner retarget<=0 resets50, scans all inflate5 sorted; each Mob targeting owner makes this Scarab target that Living mob, so last eligible sorted iterator wins, no added ally filter. Positive decrements1; dead current target cleared with native caught exception. Custom MOVE goal starts when target exists and move controller has no wanted position, continues while wanted+alive target. Start aims at target eye with speed1; tick intersecting bounding boxes calls inherited doHurtTarget EACH goal tick without local cooldown, return ignored;else squared distance<16 reissues eye chase speed1. Registered native OwnerHurtTargetGoal remains native team/admission. Attack-damage base3 is separate from color Strength/Weakness; other defense/motion bindings preserved, not silently Stage eligible. hurt ALWAYS calls server-discard helper BEFORE filtering direct ThrownPotion/AreaEffectCloud, NeoForge poison, FALL,DROWN,WITHER,WITHER_SKULL to false; remaining forwards unchanged source/amount to parent hurt. Thus rejected hurt still invokes discard; no immunity overrides that earlier callback. causeFallDamage false; no push collision; empty checkFallDamage. isFood tests empty List.of, so authored food-heal/tame interaction branches are unreachable; native spawn-egg and parent interaction remain, persistence requested only in nonfood paths. NBT saves/loads color and six found flags after parent owner state; raw persistent variantlock/clock state is not separately synchronized by these methods. Death tick20 removes KILLED/drops native experience (constructor reward0). Registry scarab_summon factory is the indexed Scarab constructor, dimensions.3/.3, registered attributes above. Cosmetic textures/animations/particles and random-stroll search are context, not new damage. Reused pinned native Mob.doHurtTarget reads current attack-damage attribute, creates mobAttack(this), applies native weapon/enchantment damage modification on server, then hurt. Only successful hurt admits native knockback, post-attack enchantment callbacks and setLastHurtMob; the custom Scarab goal ignores this boolean. Status requests above are tick-driven, not conditional on that melee return.

effects.display_name: Sealed scarab inventory native incoming summon/cleanup package
effects.actual_behavior: VICTIM Player: each prior justsummoned color flag true independently schedules4 ticks to clear that flag, without recheck. Reset six count fields to0, scan modifiable entity item handler copies: matching sealed items add stack counts. Every SingularitySatchel also adds native item-handler slot counts89brown/88green/87greengold/86iridescent/85purple/84gold, without validating the item type stored in that slot; absent capability gives empty stacks. Clamp each count>10 to10; no item consumption. For each positive color count, fresh inclusive nextInt((int)count,10)==10 admits; gold alone uses(int)Math.round(count). Nearest Scarab full-side25 selection is NOT filtered by owner or color: matching owner plus separately queried nearest persistent scarab string equal that color skips it. A nearby nonmatching scarab permits spawn without sealed-item cooldown check; only the no-nearby path skips when Player matching item is on cooldown. Spawn SCARAB_SUMMON(server,MOB_SUMMONED,event position), then successful result gets absolute(inclusive int[-1,1],0,inclusive int[-1,1]). Most justsummoned flags are set before spawn; gold no-nearby flag is set AFTER spawn. No owner/color is explicitly assigned here; first native tick owns that decision. Six independent rolls are preserved. If count sum>0, reset highestscarab=none and find highest synchronized DATA_scarab among owned Scarabs in inflate12.5, priority brown<green<greengold<iridescent<purple<gold. Second same query discards server OWNED despawnable scarabs whose synchronized color EQUALS the highest found color, not weaker colors. Player matching sealed item receives cooldown200 per admitted iterator. Proximity admission reads persistent scarab, ranking/cleanup reads synchronized DATA_scarab; no one-per-owner/color guarantee is invented.
